hypotheses.C0_native_local_reaches_half_by_256: Native local-contribution selection reaches 0.50 median fidelity by rank 256 in every cell.
hypotheses.C1_high_fidelity_is_not_sparse: Native local-contribution selection requires at least 1024 channels to reach 0.90 in every cell.
hypotheses.C2_native_basis_beats_rotation: Native local selection beats rotated local selection by at least 0.05 at rank 256 in every cell.
hypotheses.C3_activation_ranking_nearly_matches_loc: Native activation ranking is within 0.10 of local-contribution ranking at rank 256 in every cell.
hypotheses.C4_full_frontier_reconstructs: All methods reach at least 0.90 fidelity by rank 4096 in every cell.
hypotheses.C5_native_advantage_transfers_ood: The rank-256 native-minus-rotated advantage differs by at most 0.10 between corpora at each layer.
